description: This file defines the OpportunitiesJjwg_MapsLogicHook class, which contains logic hook methods for updating geocode information and related entities in the Opportunities module, integrated with the jjwg_Maps module in a SugarCRM environment.

classes.name: OpportunitiesJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: Contains logic hook methods for updating geocoding info related to Opportunities, Projects, and Meetings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the jJwg_Maps property by retrieving module info for 'jjwg_Maps'.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for an Opportunity bean before save if the feature is enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedProjectGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for related Project beans after the Opportunity is saved.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for related Meetings after the Opportunity is saved.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Handles the logic to update geocode info when a relationship is added.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Handles the logic to update geocode info when a relationship is deleted.
